editorial:
Imagine being sent to a remote island full of giant stone heads, but instead of a vacation, you are on a secret mission for the CIA. That is exactly what happens to Chris and Lee. These two partners have a messy history and a lot of secrets, but they have to play nice while dealing with a wild conspiracy in 1973 Chile. The movie feels like a sunny trip that slowly turns into a chaotic mess. You will love how the tension builds between the agents, especially when Chris starts hanging out with some local students who do not trust the government. It is funny, tense, and keeps you guessing about who is actually the bad guy.

The acting is top-notch, and the dialogue is snappy and sharp. While some parts of the plot get a bit confusing with all the political talk, the action and the laughs make up for it. If you enjoy stories where things go wrong in the funniest way possible, you need to see this. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see the beautiful island scenery, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a big movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move.
endingExplained: In the final act, you find out that the bureau chief, MJ, was actually using Chris and Lee as pawns to cover up a crime. The twist is that the rebellious students were actually spying for a different agency the whole time. Chris decides to betray the CIA to help the students escape. The movie ends with a huge shootout by the statues, and Chris and Lee barely make it off the island before the coup begins.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves spy stories with a lot of humor and unexpected twists.
